recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of six men positioned in the lower half of the frame against a large-scale vintage road map background. The image features a warm, aged texture with a slight green-yellow tint, evoking a nostalgic travel theme.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group anchored to the bottom edge
Textured map background providing thematic context
Horizontal text placement cutting across the upper third
Consistent warm lighting across all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six men arranged in a slightly staggered horizontal line, occupying the bottom 60% of the frame, scaled to waist-up or hip-up views.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the black shirt acts as the focal point, slightly forward of the others.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move outward to the flanking band members, then upward to the horizontal text and the map details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top 40% of the frame is primarily negative space filled with map details and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Olive green and parchment yellow (background map and overall tint)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues (clothing of the subjects)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and blue thin lines (highway markers on the map)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a mid-to-high value range, creating a faded, sun-bleached look.

letterConstructionRules: Motion-blur effect applied to the left side of the characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single strong display face to maintain focus on the map and subjects.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, and bold feel of the lettering.
Similar geometric structure and horizontal emphasis.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of six men in casual 2000s-era clothing (denim, button-downs, textured sweaters) standing in a row. Overlay this onto a high-detail vintage road map of the American South. Apply a warm, aged parchment texture and a slight green-yellow color grade across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text in the upper third of the image using a bold, extended, italicized sans-serif font in black. Apply a subtle horizontal motion blur to the left edge of the letters to suggest speed.

verificationChecks: Is the map texture visible through the subjects slightly?
Does the text have a horizontal speed-blur effect?
Are the colors muted and aged?

adjustableVariables: Specific color tint (e.g., more sepia vs more green)
mustRedesign: Specific road names and city labels from the original map
Exact facial features of the individuals

mustAchieve: Cohesive integration of subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the map does not look like a modern GPS interface.
Check that the text does not overlap the heads of the subjects.
Verify the motion blur on text is horizontal only.
Confirm the overall tone is nostalgic and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + Vintage Map Background + Extended Italic Typography + Aged Texture Overlay = 2000s Country/Rock Aesthetic.
